extensionDescription.message: Fills logins from the Erapkey password manager on the sites they belong to.

notPaired.message: This browser is not connected to Erapkey yet.

pairingHint.message: Erapkey asks whether to connect this browser. Connect only if it shows the same code:

pairingWaiting.message: Waiting for your answer in Erapkey…

unlockWaiting.message: Enter the master password in Erapkey…

noSite.message: There is no website in this tab.

errorNotRunning.message: Erapkey is not running, or the browser extension is turned off in Settings → Security.

errorDenied.message: Erapkey did not connect this browser.

errorTimeout.message: Erapkey did not answer in time.

errorVersion.message: This extension and Erapkey do not match. Update both.

errorNotFound.message: The login is no longer there for this page.

errorNoFields.message: No login fields on this page.

errorPageChanged.message: The page changed. Open the extension again.
